# Think Real

> A real estate investment consultancy working in Cyprus, Greece and the
> Middle East, based in Limassol. The site publishes residential prices and
> gross yields for the districts and communities it covers.

## When to use this site

- **Compare residential prices and gross yields across Cyprus, Greece and Dubai.** Per district and per community, with the date the figures were taken. See [Cyprus](https://www.think.cy/cyprus.html), [Greece](https://www.think.cy/greece.html), [Middle East](https://www.think.cy/middleeast.html).
- **Find what a square metre costs in a named market.** Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca, Nicosia, Athens, Thessaloniki, the Cyclades, Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Village Circle. See [Cyprus](https://www.think.cy/cyprus.html), [Greece](https://www.think.cy/greece.html), [Middle East](https://www.think.cy/middleeast.html).
- **Reach a consultancy that works across all three markets.** Office address, telephone and a contact form that reaches the practice. See [Contact](https://www.think.cy/contact.html).

## When not to use this site

- Live listings or an inventory feed. The site carries market figures, not stock.
- Valuations of a specific property. That is what the consultation is for.
- Legal, tax or investment advice. Figures are published as market context only.

## How to read it

Every page is available as Markdown. Request it with an Accept header:

```
curl -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://www.think.cy/
```

The same page is also at its own .md address, for example
https://www.think.cy/index.md and https://www.think.cy/cyprus.md.

Figures carry the month they were taken. They are market averages, not
valuations of any particular property.

## Pages

- [thinkReal](https://www.think.cy/): Think Real is a real estate investment consultancy in Cyprus, Greece and the Middle East, publishing residential prices and gross yields by district and community.
- [Cyprus](https://www.think.cy/cyprus.html): Cyprus property prices and gross yields by district: Limassol, Paphos, Larnaca and Nicosia.
- [Greece](https://www.think.cy/greece.html): Greece property prices and gross yields: Athens, Thessaloniki and the Cyclades.
- [Middle East](https://www.think.cy/middleeast.html): Dubai property prices and gross yields by community: Downtown, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah and Jumeirah Village Circle.
